source.callerBehavior: The ad request uses the persisted offer.id as request.attempt, rather than the underlying game attempt.id.

method: Read exact consumer function bodies from files whose Git blob hashes match the queried commit tree. Extract applyFullscreenShown and platformState bodies without rewriting them; remove only the TypeScript function signatures by placing bodies in JavaScript new Function. Execute both cases locally in Node. No dependencies, SDK or game app were installed or launched.

dependencies.platformState: Exact body extracted from the same source file.
dependencies.matchesLifeShow: Stub returns false. Neither tested placement is life-refill, so short-circuit evaluation never calls it.
dependencies.recordAdBreakShown: Stub throws if called. Neither tested placement is ads-break, so it was not called.

cases.name: P20 persisted quote identity
cases.requiredRegression: A genuine shown notice bound to the durable P20 request updates the shared fullscreen cadence once. Unbound or forged nonces remain rejected.

followup: Preserve a durable request-to-attempt binding even after earned settlement removes pending quotes. Verify shown-before-earned and earned-before-shown, relaunch, duplicate shown and quote rejection; do not solve this by accepting all arbitrary offer nonces.
limits: This is an executed narrow product pure-function check, not full application, native bridge, Android or SDK acceptance.
It does not execute original AZUR or Hitapps functions and does not change source evidence tiers.
The downstream frequency effect follows from the unmodified lastFullscreenAt and existing cadence consumers; no live ad was shown during this audit.
